The sessions command allows the user to run multiple sessios commands. 

This is currently a test version of `sessions` and can be 
installed as follows.

> **Installation**

`. net install sessions, from(https://www.pclambert.net/downloads/sessions)`

A simple example shown at the Northern European Stata Conference can be downloaded here.
